$note: Balance-as-data for sound. Every cue mapping, level and cooldown lives here; src/client/audio/ holds no literal for any of them. Asset ids under `cues[].files` are built by tools/audio/build-audio-pack.mjs and resolve to `<base><file><ext>`. Levels are linear gain, not dB. Authority for the cue list: docs/plan-audio.md §4.
$buses: Two, independently mutable. `ambience` sits far under `sfx` on purpose — plan-audio §2 rule 3: the bed must never be the reason a line is missed. The pack is foley under a reading surface, so both sit well below the level that feels right while auditing one cue at a time.
$preload: Fetched and decoded before everything else — the only cues reachable before the desk exists, O1's door and its controls. `ready` resolves on this list alone, so the door's controls answer without waiting for the whole pack.
$cues: A cue is one playable sound. `files` longer than one is a variation set — a fresh member is drawn each play, never the same one twice running. `cooldownMs` drops a retrigger inside the window, which is what keeps a burst of feed lines from stacking into a wall.

cues.$line: One per day, bound to `run:open`: the typewriter starting a fresh page. A cue on every revealed line lands ~1.5 sounds a second and turns the fanfold into a machine, so ordinary event lines are silent and only lines that carry something ring.
cues.$symptom: Deliberately the quietest one-shot in the pack. A player who notices every one of these is being told which lines carry temperament, and that is the deduction the game is made of — see plan-audio §4.2 #16.
cues.$tally-final: The ledger landing. The count-up rolls the headline for ~9 s while the row ticks all fire in its first second, so this is the full stop on the day's verdict — one struck bell, not a fourth stamp.
cues.$fallback: One degraded ROUND, not one sound per failed call — the three calls fail together far more often than separately, and a dead proxy fails all of them every beat.
cues.$door-login: The portal's LOGIN press: one press per session, and it opens a session, so it gets a switch rather than the desk's tick. Everything else on the door and on the manual sheet uses the ordinary `ui:hover` / `ui:click`, which reach them for free — both layers mount inside #app, where those listeners are delegated from.

$bindings: trigger → cue id, or null for a cue that is deliberately silent. `feed:*` fire when a line is REVEALED, not when its event arrives.

bindings.$feed-fallback: Silent: the fallback ViewEvent already sounds the degrade at the moment it happens (event:fallback:*), which is where shell/announcer.ts announces it too, and spec-client §7 #7 makes the notice LINE ride a later feed line.
bindings.$feed-wait: UNREACHABLE since x6 (08-09), which is not the same as silent. Feed cues fire when a line is REVEALED, and no wait line is revealed any more: components/run-feed.ts drops kind:'wait' before it reaches the DOM. FeedKind keeps 'wait' only because the seam is frozen (shared/view-driver.ts), so the trigger keeps its entry here - but a cue id bound at this key would sound nothing at all. The wait's audio is wait:judgment, below.
bindings.$wait-open: Silent. The loop held for the whole of every wait and a day makes three calls per beat, so it never stopped - it left being a clock and became a backing track. Bind this to `wait` to bring the ticking back on every call. THE STAKES CHANGED IN x6/x6b (08-09) - read `wait:judgment` below before touching either. The wait used to be carried by three visual channels: the fanfold's `무전 회신 대기 중` marker, the `#deployState` note under DEPLOY, and the toast. All three are gone, and the toast is not drawn at all now. So `wait:judgment` is the only signal left on any channel that a call is in flight, and unbinding it would make a working desk and a stalled one sound identical. This note used to justify the silence here by pointing at `shell/announcer.ts`, which said 무전 회신 대기 중; it no longer says it - `announcementOf` returns null for a `waiting` event.
bindings.$report: Silent. Binding a cue id here is all it takes to give the moment 「무전 기록」 lands a sound.
bindings.$door-login-null: Silent by the coexistence decision: shell/radio-sfx.ts (O3, merged in #179) plays its carrier static under the LOGIN readout, and a counter-click on top of that bed is one press sounding twice. The `door-login` cue ships; rebinding it here is one line.
bindings.$boot: Silent by the coexistence decision: the unlocking gesture is almost always the LOGIN press, which lands under radio-sfx's static bed — a stinger there is a third sound on one press. The `stinger` cue ships; rebinding it here is one line.
bindings.$collapse: Silent by the coexistence decision: 21:04 belongs to shell/radio-sfx.ts, whose day-end static swells for 1.9 s and CUTS — the silence after the cut is the cue. The ledger's row ticks still take a 2800 ms lead on the last day (the lead is keyed to the day in src/client/audio/index.ts, not to this binding), so that silence survives. The `collapse` cue ships; rebinding it here is one line, and doing so should retire the radio-sfx swell so the two never stack.

$ambience: An opening, not a bed. `playForMs` retires both loops that many ms after the desk opens and they never return, the Watch drone included. Room tone and a drone are broadband noise under a screen the player reads for minutes; held for a whole run they read as fatigue rather than atmosphere. Set `playForMs` to null to hold them for the session. `null` on a slot is silence, and that is a real choice too — the Autopsy screen is meant to be quiet.
$typing: The report is the only surface that types CHARACTERS — the LIVE FEED reveals whole LINES on U1's queue, which is what `feed:*` sounds. Sounding every character is unlistenable, so one keystroke lands every `everyChars` characters; the cue's own cooldown is the second bound.
